title: Rho tone flow
description: Page wrapper that turns the whole window dark or light to match whichever section sits in the middle of the screen: page, header and cards crossfade their colours over 0.62s as you scroll from a dark section into a light one and back.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: load); without it each section simply keeps its own tone
sections opt in with data-rho-tone="dark" | "light" (the rho blocks' tone prop sets it)
dark sections only switch when the page itself is in light mode; in dark mode everything stays dark
no crossfade under reduced motion (the colours still follow)
name: rho-tone-flow

props.name: children
props.description: the page's sections; those with data-rho-tone take part

props.name: initialTone
props.description: tone before the first section is measured
